question.:question/problem:
Given that

$$
S=\begin{bmatrix}7 & -4 & -8 \\ -3 & -4 & 3 \\ -3 & 7 & -9\end{bmatrix}
$$

which of the following elementary row operations makes $a_{31}=0$?
question.:question/worked-solution:
Of the given options, we consider the row operation

$$
{R}_{3}:={R}_{3}-{R}_{2}.
$$

At the requested entry, this gives

$$
a_{31}=-3+(-1)\cdot (-3)=0.
$$

Applying the above row operation, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}S &=\begin{bmatrix}7 & -4 & -8 \\ -3 & -4 & 3 \\ -3 & 7 & -9\end{bmatrix}\qquad {R}_{3}:={R}_{3}-{R}_{2} \\ &\sim \begin{bmatrix}7 & -4 & -8 \\ -3 & -4 & 3 \\ 0 & 11 & -12\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the required row operation is

$$
{R}_{3}:={R}_{3}-{R}_{2}.
$$
